answer.rationale: Current write latency spike at peak settlement traffic rules out rollback (security patch is non-revertible). Routing read traffic away from primary has proven effective on day 55 for latency recovery without requiring capacity addition or complex failover during critical peak. Circuit breaker is designed for dependency failures, not write path saturation. Memory_b5 demonstrates the same dashboard/reporting query pattern can reduce primary contention. With one intervention slot available during peak settlement writes, offloading read queries preserves the security patch and avoids the risk/complexity of regional failover during heavy transactional load.
